title: exemptions.v1
description: Declared, dated exemptions for the absence/drift gates: a reasoned, unexpired exemption downgrades a below-population/UNCONFIGURED failure to a reported skip, never a silent pass. Loaded by the CLI (underwrite.cli.commands.load_exemptions) from rules/exemptions.json and evaluated by underwrite_core.absence.check_population / underwrite.fleet.drift.drift_check. Validated in tests only -- the CLI itself validates the shape with plain checks.

exemptions.description: Keyed by exemption key (e.g. "ci-no-siblings", "empty-pins") -- the key a caller passes as --exemption-key, or that underwrite.fleet.drift.drift_check looks up for its two branches.

exemption.description: A single declared exemption: reason + dated expiry + owning ADR (underwrite_core.absence.Exemption).

expiry.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD); compared against the caller-supplied --now (no wall-clock fallback).

adr.description: The ADR that authorizes this exemption (optional -- underwrite_core.absence.Exemption.adr defaults to None).
